newsitem.title: FINLAND: STOCKMANN BUYS HELKAMA CAR DEALERSHIPS.
newsitem.headline: STOCKMANN BUYS HELKAMA CAR DEALERSHIPS.

text.p: Finnish retail group Stockmann said in a statement on Friday it had bought Helkama-Auto's dealerships which sell Mitsubishi and Skoda cars in Helsinki and Turku for an undisclosed sum.

It also said it would give up its Nissan, Chrysler and Jeep sales and forecast its Stockmann Auto unit's 1997 net sales at 1.8 billion markka after the rearrangements, compared with 1.4 billion last year.
"The Automotive group will employ about 540 people after the deal. Its sales target for this year is about 1.8 billion markka," Stockmann said.
Stockmann will take over the purchased units, Helkama Auto-Center (Helsinki) and Autotalo Helkama (Turku) on June 1, it said.

"The arrangement aims at strengthening the dealership network of Mitsubishi and Skoda in the capital area and in the Turku business region," Stockmann said, adding Helkama-Auto was giving up the dealership to focus on Mitsubishi and Skoda imports.
Stockmannn also sells Ford, Volkswagen, Audi and Seat cars in the Helsinki area, and Ford cars in Turku.
"Stockmann has agreed with Aro-Yhtyma to give up Nissan, Chrysler and Jeep district sales," it said.
